chars.HAMID: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, neatly trimmed short black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey joggers
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman around 26, soft round face, wearing a light pink hijab and a long lavender home kaftan
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman around 28 who lives in France, long loose wavy dark-brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a fitted red turtleneck sweater and black jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room (salon) in an apartment in Fes at night, low Moroccan sofas with patterned cushions, a brass tea tray with tea glasses, warm lamp light and blue TV glow. Seen from the doorway: SISTER sits pressed right against HAMID on the sofa, leaning her shoulder into him with a playful smile, looking at him; HAMID sits stiff and uneasy, eyes on the TV. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, subjects centred.
